label: The README's documented test command omits tests/adapter-conformance.test.cjs: section 7 lists nine files (README.md:195) and section 8 says 'tests/ nine Node test files' (README.md:235) while the folder holds ten, so an operator following the README gets a green run that never exercises the 28-case cross-adapter table its own test README calls the drift guard. This repeats the omission phase 009 fixed for the OpenCode suite. Fix: add the file, change nine to ten, and prefer the glob tests/*.test.cjs so the next suite cannot be forgotten.

The concern's README carries no frontmatter (README.md:1) while its own tests README opens with a title/description/trigger_phrases/version block (tests/README.md:1) and every other .skilled/hooks/*/README.md does the same; the block is what the trigger index reads, so the main orientation page is invisible to keyed retrieval while its test page is found. Fix: add the four-field block using the tests README's shape and phrases such as 'session relaunch' and 'skilled loop wrapper'.

ENV-REFERENCE documents every caller-facing switch (SESSION_RELAUNCH_* at :108, SYSTEM_SPEC_FOLDER at :113, CLAUDE_PID at :114) and no SKILLED_LOOP_* variable at all, although the wrapper exports the template, id, runtime and hop count (skilled-loop:393,:395,:396,:397) and both the CLI and nudge read SKILLED_LOOP_NAME (:427), SKILLED_LOOP_HOPS (:394) and SKILLED_LOOP_ID. Those are the variables that answer 'am I inside a loop', which every arm path branches on. Fix: one row per variable naming the exporter as the source, as the CLAUDE_PID row already does.

The bounded process-table read is implemented three times with the same literal bound: relaunch-core.cjs:772 and killer.cjs:188 run the identical ps -A -o pid=,ppid= with timeout 2000, and bin/session-relaunch.cjs:214 runs a third variant with comm added; the three also disagree on failure, the core returning null so the hook defers while isLoopAncestor throws so the killer aborts. Against universal-checklist.md:193 (magic values extracted to constants) and :210 (DRY: repeated rules and constants consolidated). Fix: core.readProcessTable({ withCommand = false, timeoutMs = PROCESS_TABLE_TIMEOUT_MS }) with the CLI parsing the command column through a shared parent map and the killer translating null to its throwing contract.

The packet this research feeds names a branch its predecessor and parent no longer use and still carries scaffold placeholders: 010-post-fix-research/spec.md:25 records scaffold/010-post-fix-research where the parent (spec.md:34) and the direct predecessor (009 spec.md:26) name worktrees/148-session-relaunch-deep-review, and the same file keeps template text in description (:3), Problem, Purpose, Scope and REQ-001 through REQ-002, which the strict validator's placeholder rule rejects. Fix: set Branch to the parent's worktree and author Problem, Purpose, Scope and the requirement rows from this run's synthesis before validate.sh --strict.
